intro.title: Introduction
intro.text: Maison des Bozos ("we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we handle information when you visit our website maisondesbozos.com.

collection.title: Personal Data Collection
collection.text: We do not collect any personally identifiable information when you browse our site. Analytics cookies are only used if you accept them through our consent banner.

analytics.title: Website Analytics
analytics.text: We use Fathom Analytics, a privacy-respecting analytics service. Fathom is designed to be GDPR and Quebec Law 25 compliant without requiring consent. Here's what Fathom does NOT do:
analytics.googleText: With your consent, we also use Google Analytics, a service provided by Google LLC, to better understand how our site is used (pages visited, where visitors come from, device type). Google Analytics places cookies in your browser (notably "_ga") and the data collected may be processed on servers located outside Quebec, including in the United States. This service is only activated if you accept it through our consent banner, and you can withdraw your consent at any time by deleting the cookies from your browser. For more information, see

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.text: Our site may contain links to third-party services (ticketing, social media). These services have their own privacy policies and we encourage you to review them.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.text: Under Quebec's Law 25, you have the right to access, rectify, and delete your personal data, and to withdraw your consent to analytics cookies at any time. For any request, contact us at the address below.
